title: Polynomial data of a standard smooth stage of the reduced map
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra whose reduction $\Lambda/I\Lambda$ is ind standard smooth [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras, def-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-algebra], and $A$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] with a map $\varphi:A\to\Lambda$. There are finite lists of variables $t_1,\ldots,t_n$, polynomials $g_1,\ldots,g_m\in A[t]$ and elements $\lambda_1,\ldots,\lambda_n\in\Lambda$ such that each $\varphi(g_i)(\lambda)$ belongs to $I\Lambda$ and $(A/IA)[t]/(\bar g_i)_i$ is standard smooth over $R/I$. Here $\bar g_i$ denotes coefficientwise reduction. No algebra factoring $\varphi$ over $R$ is asserted.
